# Overview

Focused comparison of **ctrl**, **24h**, and **72h**. Processing matches the all-times notebook: 10–90% trimmed cell means and skeleton means per astrocyte.

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
source("astro_analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r configuration}
DATA_PATH <- "C:/Users/talku/OneDrive/Habib Lab/CellProfiler_Results/AstroResultsAstrocytes.csv"
OUTPUT_ROOT <- "C:/Users/talku/OneDrive/Documents/HabibLab/output/ctrl_24h_72h"

TIME_ORDER <- c("ctrl", "24h", "72h")
USE_TRIMMED_MEANS <- TRUE
TRIM_LOWER <- 0.10
TRIM_UPPER <- 0.90
TOP_N_FEATURES <- 12

OUT <- make_output_folders(OUTPUT_ROOT, c("heatmaps", "stats"))
TIME_COLORS <- get_time_colors(TIME_ORDER)
```

```{r load-and-process}
cells_data <- load_astro_cells(DATA_PATH) %>%
  filter(Time %in% TIME_ORDER)

features <- identify_feature_columns(cells_data)
image_metadata <- build_image_metadata(cells_data, TIME_ORDER)
TIME_COLORS <- get_time_colors(levels(image_metadata$Time))

image_means <- build_image_means(
  cells_data = cells_data,
  cell_features = features$cell,
  skeleton_features = features$skeleton,
  image_metadata = image_metadata,
  use_trimmed = USE_TRIMMED_MEANS,
  trim_lower = TRIM_LOWER,
  trim_upper = TRIM_UPPER
)

mean_matrix <- feature_matrix(image_means, features$all)
row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Time = image_means$Time,
  row.names = rownames(mean_matrix)
)
ann_colors <- list(Time = TIME_COLORS[levels(row_annotation$Time)])
mean_method_label <- paste0(
  TRIM_LOWER * 100, "–", TRIM_UPPER * 100,
  "% trim + skeleton per cell, z-scored per feature"
)

cat("Images:", nrow(image_metadata), "\n")
```

```{r time-difference-features}
time_feature_stats <- compute_time_feature_stats(
  image_means = image_means,
  feature_cols = features$all,
  use_trimmed = USE_TRIMMED_MEANS,
  trim_lower = TRIM_LOWER,
  trim_upper = TRIM_UPPER
)
```

```{r plot-discriminating-features}
plot_time_feature_ranking(
  time_feature_stats = time_feature_stats,
  time_colors = TIME_COLORS,
  n_features = 15,
  file = file.path(OUT$stats, "discriminating_features.png"),
  title = "Features that best separate ctrl, 24h, and 72h",
  subtitle = paste0(
    "Kruskal-Wallis ε² (", TRIM_LOWER * 100, "–", TRIM_UPPER * 100,
    "% trim + skeleton per cell); dashed line = ε² 0.14"
  )
)
```

```{r heatmap-top-discriminating}
top_features <- time_feature_stats %>%
  head(TOP_N_FEATURES) %>%
  pull(Feature)

plot_image_heatmap(
  scaled_mat = scale_features(mean_matrix[, top_features, drop = FALSE]),
  row_ann = row_annotation,
  ann_colors = ann_colors,
  title = paste0(
    "Top ", TOP_N_FEATURES, " discriminating features — ctrl / 24h / 72h\n(",
    mean_method_label, ")"
  ),
  file = file.path(OUT$heatmaps, "top_discriminating.png"),
  fontsize_row = 11,
  fontsize_col = 11
)

cat("ctrl/24h/72h plots saved to:", OUTPUT_ROOT, "\n")
```
